title: Goldilocks and the Three Bears
source: English fairy tale (Robert Southey, 1837; Joseph Jacobs, 1890, public domain). Original retelling.
moral: Always ask before you use what belongs to someone else.

pages.text: Once upon a time, three bears lived in a cosy cottage in the woods.
pages.caption: Three bears at home

pages.text: There was a great big Papa Bear, a middle-sized Mama Bear, and a wee little Baby Bear.
pages.caption: Papa, Mama, Baby

pages.text: One morning, Mama Bear made porridge. But it was too hot! "Let's go for a walk," she said.
pages.caption: Porridge too hot

pages.text: Along came a little girl with golden curls. Her name was Goldilocks.
pages.caption: Here comes Goldilocks

pages.text: She peeped in the window. She knocked on the door. Knock, knock! Nobody was home.
pages.caption: Knock, knock!

pages.text: Goldilocks tasted the big bowl of porridge. "Ooh! Too hot!"
pages.caption: Too hot!

pages.text: She tasted the middle bowl. "Brr! Too cold!"
pages.caption: Too cold!

pages.text: She tasted the wee little bowl. "Mmm! Just right!" And she ate it all up. Slurp!
pages.caption: Just right!

pages.text: Goldilocks sat in the big chair. Too hard! She sat in the middle chair. Too soft!
pages.caption: Too hard, too soft

pages.text: She sat in the wee little chair. Just right! But then... CRACK! It broke to bits.
pages.caption: Crack goes the chair

pages.text: Goldilocks was sleepy. The big bed was too high. The middle bed was too bumpy.
pages.caption: Too high, too bumpy

pages.text: The wee little bed was just right. She snuggled down and fell fast asleep. Zzz.
pages.caption: Fast asleep

pages.text: Home came the three bears. "Someone has been eating my porridge!" said Papa Bear.
pages.caption: The bears come home

pages.text: "Someone has been sitting in my chair!" said Baby Bear. "And it is all broken!"
pages.caption: My chair is broken

pages.text: "Someone is sleeping in my bed!" squeaked Baby Bear. Goldilocks woke up with a jump!
pages.caption: Goldilocks wakes up

pages.text: "I'm sorry," said Goldilocks. "Next time I will knock and wait." The bears shared their porridge. The end.
pages.caption: Sorry and sharing
